caption: One block holds 1,000 transactions of 500 bytes and arrives every 12 s: that gives 83.33 tx/s, while 7,200 blocks a day add 3.6 GB to every full node's disk. The two highlighted numbers are the two limits that pull against decentralisation.

spec.aria: Flowchart: a block of 1,000 transactions of 500 bytes arriving every 12 s yields 83.33 tx/s, and 7,200 blocks a day grow the ledger by 3.6 GB per day.
